origin.description: Assign the backports that R itself does not already provide.

arguments.name: obj
arguments.text: Names to copy. NULL means every backport newer than version.

arguments.name: force
arguments.text: Copy obj even when this R already has it.

arguments.name: version
arguments.text: R version used to read the table. Default 4.5.0.

origin.details: The version table is newest first. import stops at the first version that is less than or equal to the running R and copies only the names above it. The default here is 4.5.0, so the list is empty and nothing is assigned. Pass an older version to see what that R would receive.
origin.value: TRUE when the call finishes. On 4.5.0 no names are copied.
origin.example:
bp_import <- getFromNamespace("import", "backports")
cat(bp_import("backports"), "
", sep = "")
cat(paste(getFromNamespace("get_backports", "backports")("3.5.0"), collapse = "
"), "
", sep = "")
